correctness.rationale: A positive admissible binary expansion is uniquely 1(1|00)*. The number of length-L words is F_L. For every nonmaximum word its last 00 tile followed only by ones determines a unique numeric successor, and a direct suffix subtraction gives gap Δ_t=2^t+2 (even t) or 2^t+1 (odd t). Prefixes of length L-t-2 number F_(L-t-2) and sum to F_L-1: all within-layer gaps accounted for, including t=0,1 both giving gap3. Boundary gaps alternate 1 and2; summing Fibonacci counts across dyadic layers and taking ratios gives masses 1/φ at3 and φ^(-(t+2)) at t>=2. Independently enumerated complete layer gaps up to L=16.
residual_risks: Finite independent computations are corroboration only; proof needs all parameter quantifiers and regularity hypotheses.
